about.commitmentDesc: We are committed to data privacy, secure access, and building tools that actually match how schools work every day.
about.label: About Imboni
about.missionDesc: To simplify school life by connecting every stakeholder (students, teachers, parents, and boarding staff) on one clear and reliable platform.
about.quote: "A school runs on communication. Imboni makes sure that communication is clear, timely, and reaches the right people, every time."
about.serveDesc: Imboni is built for boarding schools that want to bring clarity, transparency, and efficiency to every part of school operations.
about.subtitle: Imboni was designed from the ground up for boarding schools, where students, teachers, parents, and residential staff all need to stay connected and informed every single day.
about.title: Built around your school community
